notes:
Your config stays the way you wrote it. Still on the Serenity Desktop App's 1.52.

- **Changes keep the file's own look.** When the Framework changes the Hub's `config.json` (a site, a server, a folder, an app's category), whatever the change didn't touch is now written back exactly as it was. An entry you keep on one line stays on one line, with its own spacing, and a new entry in a list of one-line entries is one line too. Before, any change spread one-line entries over several lines.
- If the result ever wouldn't read back as exactly the right config, it's written the old way instead. A backup is still kept beside the file before the first change.
